payload.title: omp isolated copy can run from the line only while the dispatcher's checkout is clean
payload.body: Measured on omp 18.4.9 (temp repo, PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR with task.isolation enabled, apply false, merge branch): a dispatcher tool_call handler can revise a task's input to isolated:true; the copy is cut from the dispatcher's checkout (HEAD ab0a949 = main, not the line tip 4b82bc1) and no ref can be given; a session_start handler in the sub session (ctx.agent.kind==='sub', ctx.cwd the copy) can 'git checkout --detach <line>' inside the copy, the copy sees the source refs. With a CLEAN dispatcher checkout omp then fetches the agent's own commits to omp/task/<id> in the parent repo (d80409c, line IS ancestor, main git status unchanged). With a DIRTY dispatcher checkout (uncommitted or untracked files) omp replays the agent's commits against the baseline WIP onto the dispatcher's HEAD: the branch had no line history and the agent's hashes were lost. A realization would need host settings task.isolation.enabled true, apply false, merge branch (global, changing the operator's own isolated tasks), a way to hand the line tip to the child, and a clean-checkout guard on dispatch. omp-implementer-worktree of remaining-gaps did not build it and states the shortfall instead.
